label: THE_FADE_PHASE2_T74_AMEND_MVP_APPROVAL_SCOPE_TO_SCOPED_MVP_PATH
canonical_file_role: Single machine-readable Phase 2 MVP approval-scope decision on disk. T73 (Prompt #325) previously locked all-lanes-required + full six-dimension closure; T74 (Prompt #326) supersedes that policy shape only inside this file — not a second decision file.

current_approval_truth.note: Mirrors binding file as of T74. T74 does not edit mvp_lane_approval.json and does not flip approval.

approval_scope_policy.eligibility_rule_single_reading: A future approval flip (editing mvp_lane_approval.json to set approved:true and/or to make approved_mvp_lanes non-empty) becomes ELIGIBLE only if ALL of the following are true at flip time: (1) lane_b_official_disclosure satisfies primary_lane_rule in this file; (2) at least TWO distinct lanes from support_lane_pool satisfy support_lane_rule in this file; (3) a later governed approval-decision tranche documents explicit operator signoff on disk (governed prompt + aligned control docs). If any condition fails, the flip is not eligible under this scoped MVP path.

requirements: In mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json at flip time, lane_b_official_disclosure must have no dimension_evidence_status value equal to not_started for any of the six MVP dimensions.

For every MVP dimension, Lane B must have either (a) on-disk evidence that satisfies the operator at the Phase 2 MVP source-reliability audit bar for that dimension, or (b) an explicit operator-accepted governance treatment on disk (charter clause, decision JSON, or evidence log entry) that names the residual gap and accepts it for this scoped MVP path.
Lane B must be the lane the operator explicitly treats as the primary disclosure anchor in the approval-decision tranche — not merely the historically deepest or most interesting lane.

as_of_t74_on_disk_assessment.honest_reason_not_met: All six dimensions remain partial in the registry; residual gaps are not closed at full gate bar and there is no on-disk operator-accepted governance treatment that formally accepts each residual gap for scoped MVP approval. Therefore primary_lane_rule is NOT satisfied as of T74.

counts_toward_eligibility_only_if_all_tr: Exactly one bounded live observe-or-honest-failure HTTPS slice has executed for that lane against a charter-locked or log-locked source URL (normalized_signal_event or scout_failure both count as honest slice outcomes).
mvp_lane_evidence_registry.json shows evidence_status at least partial for that lane.
An explicit slice stop, default freeze for new live evidence, or stop-for-now lock for that lane exists on disk (e.g., charter stop clause or equivalent governance doc).
Six-dimension full closure for that support lane is NOT required for this scoped MVP path — slice-1 minimum only.
support_lane_rule.explicit_non_claim: Satisfying support_lane_rule does not assert that the support lane is mature on all MVP dimensions; it only satisfies the slice-1 minimum for counting toward the two-of-three support-lane requirement.

dimension_policy.scoped_mvp_approval_eligibility_meaning: Primary lane (lane_b_official_disclosure) must satisfy primary_lane_rule (strict bar: no not_started; every dimension closed at bar or explicitly accepted on disk). Each lane counted toward the two support lanes must satisfy support_lane_rule (bounded live slice + partial + stop/freeze lock) only. Full six-dimension closure across all four deferred lanes is NOT required for approval eligibility under this amended scope. This is not a claim that every deferred lane is production-mature.

lane_posture_policy.t74_note: T74 does not reopen any lane; posture unchanged from T71-era stops and Lane B default freeze.

deferred_from_scoped_mvp_path: Full six-dimension MVP closure on all support lanes (A/C/E)
Phase 3 universe scanner, runtime, dashboard, and production integration
not_sufficient_for_approval: Another random evidence slice without a new explicit charter for that lane
Support-lane activity or slice history without primary_lane_rule satisfaction for Lane B
Silent or verbal-only operator acceptance not written into on-disk governance (charter, decision file, evidence log, or checklist)
Strong Lane B slices alone while primary_lane_rule remains unsatisfied

allowed_next_tranche_classes: Exactly one new explicit Lane B charter tranche naming one sharply bounded objective tied to satisfying primary_lane_rule (authoring and/or bounded execution only as that charter permits)
Exactly one approval-decision tranche only if scoped-MVP eligibility per this file is already satisfied on disk and the governed prompt contains explicit operator signoff
Exactly one governance hold tranche (doc-only pause; no collection)
forbidden_next_without_new_governance: New live evidence on lanes A/C/E by default (charter-first; no ad-hoc observe passes)
Multi-lane simultaneous reopen or multi-lane live collection
Phase 3 implementation or Phase 3 scoping work
mvp_lane_approval.json approval flip without satisfying approval_scope_policy and primary_lane_rule and support_lane_rule as written in this amended file
Second concurrent Lane B charter or overlapping bounded objectives without a new tranche that explicitly rescopes

anti_drift_rule.statement: No Phase 3 work (scanner, runtime, dashboard, production integration) before an explicit governed approval-decision tranche that either (a) satisfies this file's scoped MVP eligibility preconditions and edits mvp_lane_approval.json with explicit operator signoff, or (b) amends governance in writing without starting Phase 3. This rule does not reintroduce all-lanes-required or full six-dimension closure across all four lanes as a precondition for Phase 3 — only the no-Phase-3-until-explicit-approval-decision discipline.
